basis: Implemented local game source; working tree may contain unreleased changes.

entities.name: Wood
entities.description: Split birch and pine. Walls, floors, fuel and the hafts of tools.

entities.name: Oak Wood
entities.description: Dense, pale-hearted oak. Too hard for flint - but it makes the best hafts and beams.

entities.name: Stone
entities.description: Grey fieldstone, knocked loose from boulders.

entities.name: Flint
entities.description: A glassy nodule with a chalky rind. Knapped, it takes an edge sharp enough to cut wood.

entities.name: Iron Ore
entities.description: Rust-veined ore broken from the orange seams in the rocks. Useless until it is smelted.

entities.name: Iron Bar
entities.description: A bloom of iron, hammered into a bar. Ready for the forge.

entities.name: Raw Hide
entities.description: A raw pelt. It will stiffen and rot unless it is cured.

entities.name: Leather
entities.description: Cured, supple leather. Straps, grips, armour.

entities.name: Charger Tusk
entities.description: A curved, heavy tusk from a Charger. Hard enough to bite into ore.

entities.name: Pine Resin
entities.description: Sticky amber gum that weeps from felled pines. It seals wounds and burns well.

entities.name: Moonpetal
entities.description: Pale moonpetals from beneath the forest canopy. Bitter, cooling, cleansing.

entities.name: Redcap
entities.description: A red-capped mushroom that grows in deep shade. Warming; it thickens the blood.

entities.name: Flax
entities.description: Blue-flowered flax from the meadows. Its fibres spin into cord and linen.

entities.name: Echo Crystal
entities.description: A shard that hums with the memory of the old world. The Echo stones answer to it.

entities.name: Healing Draught
entities.description: A thick red draught. Restores 40 health. One every 30 seconds.

entities.name: Wound Salve
entities.description: A green, cooling salve of moonpetal bound in pine resin. It draws out rot.

entities.name: Linen Bandage
entities.description: Clean linen strips, rolled tight.

entities.name: Guardian's Heart
entities.description: Still warm. The stone heart of the Ancient Guardian pulses with captured light.

entities.name: Echo Focus
entities.description: Two echo crystals caged in forged iron and bound with leather. Old shrines will pour what they keep into it.

entities.name: Raw Meat
entities.description: Lean, dark meat from a wild creature. Cook it at a fire before you eat it.

entities.name: Grilled Meat
entities.description: Meat seared over the fire. Eaten, it keeps you going: more stamina, faster breath and slow healing for six minutes.

entities.name: Hunter's Stew
entities.description: Meat, redcaps and moonpetal simmered for hours. A full belly for ten minutes: much more stamina, steady healing.

entities.name: Barley
entities.description: Bearded heads of wild barley from the open meadows. Ground on a flat stone it makes bread; it also sprouts in a garden bed.

entities.name: Barley Flatbread
entities.description: Barley flatbread baked on a hot stone. Plain, filling, long-lasting: more stamina and slow healing for eight minutes.

entities.name: Redcap Skewer
entities.description: Redcaps threaded on a green stick and charred over the coals. A quick bite: a little more stamina for four minutes.

entities.name: Vigor Tonic
entities.description: Moonpetal and redcap steeped in sour barley water. Drink it and your breath comes back half again as fast for three minutes.

entities.name: Ironbark Brew
entities.description: A bitter, black brew of oak shavings and pine resin. The skin tightens like bark: a quarter less damage for two and a half minutes.

entities.name: Stalker Trophy
entities.description: The scarred head of a Stalker that was more than it should have been. Hunters of old wore their fangs.

entities.name: Charger Trophy
entities.description: The great tusked skull of an elite Charger. Bound to oak it makes a totem that hits like the beast did.

entities.name: Bucket
entities.description: Staves of split pine in a leather band, sealed with resin. Wade into water (or draw from a well) to fill it.

entities.name: Bucket of Water
entities.description: A bucket of clear water. A freshly planted garden bed needs one before it will grow (rain does it for you).

entities.name: Bone
entities.description: Grey, dry bones from the barrow dead. Ground, they feed a garden; carved, they tip arrows; boiled, they make a broth.

entities.name: Grave Iron
entities.description: Rusted scraps of the grave goods the Hollows were buried with. The bloomery smelts two of them into a bar.

entities.name: Greyhorn Antler
entities.description: A tine from a Greyhorn's broad antler. Hard, springy and lighter than iron: picks and horn bows.

entities.name: Raw Venison
entities.description: A dark haunch of Greyhorn venison. Roast it at a fire.

entities.name: Flint Arrows
entities.description: Ash shafts with knapped flint heads and grey fletching. Loosed from any bow.

entities.name: Bone Arrows
entities.description: Barbed bone points: they bite deeper and stagger harder than flint.

entities.name: Iron Arrows
entities.description: Forged bodkins. They punch through hide and old iron alike.

entities.name: Fire Arrows
entities.description: A resin-soaked rag behind a small iron point. Whatever it strikes catches fire.

entities.name: Greyhorn Trophy
entities.description: The antlered head of a Greyhorn bull that would not run. Its strength goes into a charm of quick feet.

entities.name: Hollow Trophy
entities.description: A rusted helm on a grinning skull; the cold light still moves in the sockets. Bound in a charm, it wards off grave rot.

entities.name: Venison Roast
entities.description: Venison roasted with moonpetal over the coals. A great deal more stamina and good healing (12 min).

entities.name: Bone Broth
entities.description: Bones simmered for a day with redcap and moonpetal. Warms you through: the fastest healing of any meal (9 min).

entities.name: Barley Porridge
entities.description: Barley boiled thick with a few redcaps. Plain and filling: more stamina and slow healing (10 min).

entities.name: Grave Ward
entities.description: A pale draught of bone ash, moonpetal and resin. For four minutes grave rot cannot take hold of you, and the dead hit you a quarter less hard.

entities.name: Whetstone
entities.description: A fine-grained stone. Hone the weapon in your hand: +15% damage for five minutes.

entities.name: Bone Meal
entities.description: Bones ground to a pale meal at the stonecutter's quern. Worked into a garden bed, it brings the crop up in half the time.

entities.name: Bogwalker's Balm
entities.description: A sharp-smelling balm of moonpetal, resin and flax oil, rubbed into the skin. For six minutes the Mire's webs slide off you and spider venom cannot take hold.

entities.name: Warming Draught
entities.description: Redcaps boiled down with resin and moonpetal until it burns going down. For six minutes the Highland cold cannot reach you.

entities.name: Silver
entities.description: Hacksilver: cut coins, rings and bits of chain, weighed rather than counted. The trader takes it, and pays in it.

entities.name: Cloudberries
entities.description: Amber berries from the low bushes of Birchwood, sweet and sharp. Nowhere else in the Vale do they ripen.

entities.name: Spider Silk
entities.description: Pale, strong silk from the nests of the Mire spiders. Finer than flax, and it never rots.

entities.name: Frost Lichen
entities.description: A grey-blue crust that grows only on the frozen Highland rocks. Chewed, it numbs; brewed, it warms.

entities.name: Amber
entities.description: Old resin turned to stone, prised from the roots of the great Elderwood oaks. Warm to the touch, and something hums inside.

entities.name: Cloudberry Tart
entities.description: Cloudberries baked into barley dough. Sweet and quick: more stamina and the fastest breath of any meal (8 min).

entities.name: Silk Bandage
entities.description: Spider silk woven tight with moonpetal. Wrapped round a wound it stops the bleeding at once: 60 health over a few seconds.

entities.name: Keepers' Key
entities.description: Iron forged with amber from the Elderwood, frost lichen from the heights, Mire silk and Birchwood cloudberries, as the Keepers forged theirs. It fits the seal on the Courtyard gate.

entities.name: Flint Axe
entities.description: A knapped flint wedge lashed into a split haft. It bites birch and pine.

entities.name: Iron Axe
entities.description: A bearded iron axe. Heavy enough for old oak.

entities.name: Stone Pickaxe
entities.description: A pointed stone bound to a haft. It breaks fieldstone, but iron seams turn it aside.

entities.name: Tusk Pickaxe
entities.description: A Charger's tusk lashed to a haft. Hard enough to bite into iron ore.

entities.name: Antler Pickaxe
entities.description: A Greyhorn tine lashed across an ash haft. Lighter than tusk and quicker in the hand; it bites iron ore.

entities.name: Iron Pickaxe
entities.description: A forged pick. It splits anything - even the humming echo crystals.

entities.name: Wooden Club
entities.description: A knotted length of hardwood. Crude, but it staggers.

entities.name: Flint Spear
entities.description: An ash shaft with a knapped flint point. Reach keeps the teeth away.

entities.name: Iron Spear
entities.description: A leaf-bladed iron spear. Precise, long, unforgiving.

entities.name: Iron Blades
entities.description: A pair of short seax blades. Fast, evasive - and cruel from behind.

entities.name: Iron Mace
entities.description: Six iron flanges round an oak haft. It does not cut; it breaks. Shields, helms and the dead all fold under it.

entities.name: Torch
entities.description: A stick with resin-soaked linen bound round the head. Held, it lights the dark briefly, and a blow with it sets creatures alight. Burned out, rekindle it at a workbench (repair) or make another.

entities.name: Hunting Bow
entities.description: An ash flatbow. Hold left attack to draw, release to loose; right attack cancels. Exhaustion cancels too. Early shots scatter; full draws usually strike critically. Upgrades improve draw speed and accuracy.

entities.name: Horn Bow
entities.description: An oak, antler and sinew recurve. Quicker and more accurate than a hunting bow. Left attack draws, release looses; right attack or exhaustion cancels. Upgrades improve handling. Arrows arc over distance.

entities.name: Lute
entities.description: A round-backed lute of oak staves with flax-gut strings. Take it in hand to play: real notes, and loops you can layer. Music by the fire rests whoever hears it.

entities.name: Leather Bracers
entities.description: Laced leather guards for the forearms.

entities.name: Hide Vest
entities.description: Layered hide and leather over the tunic.

entities.name: Fur Mantle
entities.description: A shaggy mantle. Warm, and it turns a claw.

entities.name: Leather Cap
entities.description: A stitched leather cap with a fur trim and ear flaps. Warm, and better than a bare head.

entities.name: Iron Helm
entities.description: A spectacle helm with a mail aventail.

entities.name: Iron Lamellar
entities.description: Laced iron plates over a padded coat.

entities.name: Iron Spaulders
entities.description: Riveted iron shoulder plates.

entities.name: Hallvard's Axe
entities.description: The watchman's own bearded axe, its haft worn pale where his hands held it. Runes run along the cheek of the blade: KEEP THE HEARTH.

entities.name: Fang Charm
entities.description: An elite Stalker's fangs strung on braided flax. Its bite lives on in yours: +12% attack damage.

entities.name: Tusk Totem
entities.description: A sliver of elite Charger tusk lashed to an oak peg. Your blows land with the beast's weight: +40% stagger.

entities.name: Hearth Charm
entities.description: A drop of resin around a crystal chip, still warm from the fire it was set in. Breath comes back 20% faster.

entities.name: Keeper's Sigil
entities.description: Hallvard's bronze sigil of the Keepers of the Vale: the Beacon over a ring of runes. The old knowledge comes easier to whoever wears it: skills grow 20% faster, breath 8%.

entities.name: Grave Charm
entities.description: A Hollow's finger bone and a rusted grave ring on a cord, with a chip of the cold light. Grave rot cannot take hold of you, and you hit 6% harder.

entities.name: Stag Charm
entities.description: A polished tine from a Greyhorn bull that stood its ground. Light on your feet: 8% faster, breath 5%.

entities.name: Amber Charm
entities.description: Three drops of Elderwood amber in a leather knot, one with a moth caught inside it. The old forest's patience: skills grow 10% faster, breath 10%.

entities.name: Linen Bandage
entities.description: Flax fibre beaten, spun and woven into clean strips.

entities.name: Bucket
entities.description: Staves of split pine bound with a leather band and sealed with resin. Carry water to the garden: wade into a stream or a pond to fill it, or draw from a well.

entities.name: Flint Arrows
entities.description: Ten ash shafts, knapped flint points, fletched with grey goose feathers from the marsh.

entities.name: Bone Arrows
entities.description: Ten barbed bone points from the barrow dead: deeper wounds, harder stagger.

entities.name: Fire Arrows
entities.description: Eight arrows with resin-soaked flax bound behind the point. They set whatever they strike alight.

entities.name: Ground Whetstones
entities.description: Three hones ground true on the grindstone's wheel. Cheaper than the stonecutter's, and as keen.

entities.name: Healing Draught
entities.description: Moonpetal steeped with redcap. Drink to restore 40 health.

entities.name: Wound Salve
entities.description: Moonpetal ground into warm pine resin. It cleans a wound and keeps the rot out.

entities.name: Vigor Tonic
entities.description: Sour barley water with moonpetal and redcap steeped in it. Stamina comes back 50% faster for three minutes.

entities.name: Ironbark Brew
entities.description: Oak shavings boiled black with resin and redcap. Take a quarter less damage for two and a half minutes.

entities.name: Bogwalker's Balm
entities.description: Moonpetal and resin worked into flax oil. For six minutes the Mire's webs slide off you and spider venom cannot take hold.

entities.name: Warming Draught
entities.description: Redcaps boiled down with resin until it burns going down. For six minutes the Highland cold cannot reach you.

entities.name: Grave Ward
entities.description: Bone ash, moonpetal and resin. For four minutes grave rot cannot take hold, and the dead hit a quarter less hard.

entities.name: Silk Bandage
entities.description: Mire silk woven tight round crushed moonpetal. Two bandages: each heals 60 at once and draws out grave rot.

entities.name: Lichen Tea
entities.description: Frost lichen steeped hot with moonpetal: the Highlands' own cure for their cold. Two Warming Draughts.

entities.name: Grilled Meat
entities.description: Seared on a stick over the coals. Eat it for more stamina, faster recovery and slow healing (6 min).

entities.name: Hunter's Stew
entities.description: A thick stew of meat, redcaps and moonpetal. Much more stamina and steady healing (10 min).

entities.name: Redcap Skewer
entities.description: Redcaps charred on a green stick. A quick bite: a little more stamina (4 min).

entities.name: Barley Flatbread
entities.description: Barley ground on a flat stone, mixed with water and baked on the hearthstones. Two loaves: more stamina and slow healing (8 min).

entities.name: Venison Roast
entities.description: A Greyhorn haunch roasted slowly with moonpetal. The best meal in the Vale: much more stamina and good healing (12 min).

entities.name: Bone Broth
entities.description: Bones simmered with redcap and moonpetal. Two bowls: the fastest healing of any meal (9 min).

entities.name: Barley Porridge
entities.description: Barley boiled thick with redcaps. Two bowls: more stamina and slow healing (10 min).

entities.name: Cloudberry Tart
entities.description: Birchwood cloudberries baked into barley dough. Two tarts: more stamina and the fastest breath of any meal (8 min).

entities.name: Iron Arrows
entities.description: Ten forged bodkin points on ash shafts. They punch through hide and old iron alike.

entities.name: Echo Focus
entities.description: A cage of forged iron around two echo crystals. A vessel for whatever an old shrine keeps.

entities.name: Whetstone
entities.description: Two fine-grained stones, sawn and dressed. Hone the weapon in your hand: +15% damage for five minutes.

entities.name: Bone Meal
entities.description: Bones ground at the quern. Worked into a garden bed, it brings the crop up in half the time.

entities.name: Keepers' Key
entities.description: Iron forged with a piece of each outer land, the way the Keepers made theirs. It breaks the seal on the Courtyard gate.

entities.name: Ember Relic
entities.description: Relic: hitting Staggered or Exposed enemies sets them ablaze, and fire spreads between creatures.

entities.name: Echo Attunement
entities.description: Crystal resonance: all Echoes last 50% longer and recover faster.

entities.name: Stalker
entities.description: Circles its prey, then commits to a lunge. Dodge or parry the lunge and punish its recovery.

entities.name: Charger
entities.description: An aggressive beast with a headbutt, a committed charge and a close-range stomp. Crowding or circling its flanks can trigger a 360-degree stomp with 12 knockback: leave the marked 3.2 m circle during the 1.05-second warning; it recovers for 1.4 seconds and has a 6-second stomp cooldown. Bait its charge into an obstacle to stun it.

entities.name: Hollow
entities.description: A shield-bearing undead warrior. Frontal light hits and arrows glance off its guard; heavy blows break it. Watch for a two-hit combo (both blows are marked on the ground) and a leap. Its blade carries grave rot.

drops.quantity: 1 or 2 (50% each) at level 1; always 2 at level 2+

entities.name: Greyhorn
entities.description: A grazing herd animal. Cows flee; injured bulls can turn and gore or charge. Level 1 has a 35% chance to be a bull; level 2+ is always a bull.

entities.name: Mire Spider
entities.description: Keeps its distance, spits slowing webs, then darts in to bite. Venom prevents healing. Bring Bogwalker’s Balm to protect against venom and webs.

entities.name: Ancient Guardian
entities.description: The boss of the Forgotten Courtyard. Since v0.19 the Courtyard gate is sealed until the Keepers’ trials are passed, every unlockable companion (currently Mira) has joined, and a Keepers’ Key is set in the seal (see [the journey](/progression/)). Bait a charge into a wall or restored Echo pillar: the impact removes 5% of its maximum health and leaves it staggered for 3.5 seconds and Exposed for 4.5 seconds. Below half health it moves and attacks faster. Echoes help but are not required.

entities.name: Workbench
entities.description: Tools, weapons, leatherwork, linen and equipment repairs.

entities.name: Herbalist's Table
entities.description: Draughts, salves, tonics and protective preparations.

entities.name: Forge
entities.description: Iron equipment, repairs and progression rites.

entities.name: Stonecutter
entities.description: Stone construction, whetstones and bone meal.

entities.name: Tanning Rack
entities.description: Cures hides into leather, including while away or asleep, but not while rain falls on it: give it a roof.

entities.name: Bloomery
entities.description: Smelts iron ore or grave iron into bars using wood as fuel.

entities.name: Hearth
entities.description: Cook food at the homestead hearth or a built campfire.
